label: Zyxel GS1900-8HP
description: Zyxel GS1900-8HP - 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45, all eight PoE+ (802.3at, 30 W/port) against a 77 W budget, fanless desktop smart-managed switch with no SFP.

poe.note: IEEE 802.3at PoE+ on all eight copper ports at up to 30 W per port against a 77 W total budget, so the budget and not the port count is the binding limit: two 30 W PDs plus a third at 17 W already fills it. The user guide LED table numbers these as PoE 10/100/1000Base-T Ports (1 - 8), so every copper port is a PSE port. Default consumption mode powers only what the PD asks for and reserves the remainder; PoE can be scheduled per time range; a PoE MODE button turns the port LEDs into PoE state LEDs.

fabric.note: Zyxel quotes 16 Gbps switching capacity and 11.9 Mpps forwarding rate, with a 525 K packet buffer, an 8 K MAC address table and 9 K jumbo frames.

notes: Zyxel GS1900 Series datasheet (dated 16/11/22) https://static.us.zyxel.com/pdf/2024/switch/ds_GS1900-10HP.pdf; specification table https://www.zyxel.com/global/en/products/switch/gs1900-series/specification. Management and switching features from the datasheet feature list and the GS1900 Series User Guide V2.90 Edition 2 https://download.zyxel.com/GS1900-48HPv2/user_guide/GS1900-48HPv2_V2.90_Ed2.pdf. There is NO console port and no CLI anywhere in the series: management is the web GUI, SNMP v1/v2/v3, RMON 1/2/3/9, syslog, LLDP/LLDP-MED, 802.1x, RADIUS and TACACS+, which is why no device here declares cli. Eight-port PoE model: total port count 8, eight 802.3at PoE ports, 77 W budget, 84.8 W maximum consumption, 250 x 104 x 27 mm, 0.71 kg, fanless (0 dBA). The datasheet ordering table lists GS1900-8HP-EU0103F / -US0103F / -USAM03F as hardware revision B2, with B1 part numbers (EU0102F / US0102F / USAM02F) still listed.
